def solve(gg):
    H=len(gg); W=len(gg[0]); dash=3
    out=[r[:] for r in gg]; filled=[]
    orients=[('row',0,1),('col',1,0),('diag',1,1),('anti',1,-1)]
    for kind,dr,dc in orients:
        lines={}
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if gg[r][c]!=dash: continue
                if kind=='row': k=r
                elif kind=='col': k=c
                elif kind=='diag': k=r-c
                else: k=r+c
                lines.setdefault(k,[]).append((r,c))
        for k,cs in lines.items():
            if len(cs)<3: continue
            keyf=(lambda p:p[1]) if dr==0 else (lambda p:p[0])
            cs=sorted(cs,key=keyf)
            runs=[]; cur=[cs[0]]
            for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
                if b[0]-a[0]==dr and b[1]-a[1]==dc: cur.append(b)
                else: runs.append(cur); cur=[b]
            runs.append(cur)
            last=runs[-1]
            if len(last)<2: continue
            r,c=last[-1]; fill=[]
            while True:
                r,c=r+dr,c+dc
                if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): break
                fill.append((r,c))
            if len(fill)<2: continue
            for rr,cc in fill:
                if gg[rr][cc]==7:
                    out[rr][cc]=1; filled.append((rr,cc))
    return out,filled

def solve_c(gg,dash,bg,fillc=1):
    H=len(gg); W=len(gg[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in gg]; filled=[]
    for kind,dr,dc in [('row',0,1),('col',1,0),('diag',1,1),('anti',1,-1)]:
        lines={}
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if gg[r][c]!=dash: continue
                k = r if kind=='row' else c if kind=='col' else r-c if kind=='diag' else r+c
                lines.setdefault(k,[]).append((r,c))
        for k,cs in lines.items():
            if len(cs)<3: continue
            keyf=(lambda p:p[1]) if dr==0 else (lambda p:p[0])
            cs=sorted(cs,key=keyf)
            runs=[]; cur=[cs[0]]
            for a,b in zip(cs,cs[1:]):
                if b[0]-a[0]==dr and b[1]-a[1]==dc: cur.append(b)
                else: runs.append(cur); cur=[b]
            runs.append(cur)
            if len(runs[-1])<2: continue
            r,c=runs[-1][-1]; fill=[]
            while True:
                r,c=r+dr,c+dc
                if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): break
                fill.append((r,c))
            if len(fill)<2: continue
            for rr,cc in fill:
                if gg[rr][cc]==bg:
                    out[rr][cc]=fillc; filled.append((rr,cc))
    return out,filled
